**Fastest route:** email <goproductmgt@gmail.com>. Questions about a record you bought, an order or a receipt go there, never here — this issue tracker is public.

**Connection steps for every client** (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok) are on the help page: <https://app.goodleads.club/connect.html>. If your client says the connection failed, wait a minute and retry — the door restarts briefly during releases.
